description: Static, purely upstream-derived identity for one MAV_CMD_* entry -- name, numeric value, and param roster (index/name/enumRef). Shared by that command's mission/ and command/ compatibility docs (schema/command.schema.json), which carry no identity of their own beyond 'name' and 'context'. Kept in sync with upstream MAVLink XML by scripts/generate_stubs.py (initial creation) and scripts/check_sync.py (additions/renames) -- never hand-edited beyond what those produce, since it holds no human-entered compatibility data.

params.description: Keyed by '<index>_<name>' (e.g. '1_Pitch') -- index and name are encoded in the key, not repeated as separate fields. May be empty for a command with no upstream params at all.
